verdict.rationale: Pulumi provides the building blocks for agent-gated automation: policy-as-code guardrails (pulumi-docs-5/16), a non-mutating `preview` step that can be inspected before `up` (pulumi-docs-8/19, pulumi-probe-6), a headless CLI/Automation API usable by agents (pulumi-docs-2, pulumi-probe-7), and an official MCP server that lets AI assistants query/generate but also 'optionally delegate tasks to Pulumi Neo' (pulumi-docs-7/18/26, pulumi-probe-8). However, there's no direct evidence of least-privilege credential scoping for agents or an explicit human-approval gate before apply, and Neo is described as autonomously 'executing changes... automatically' (pulumi-docs-20), which runs somewhat counter to a strict review-gate model.
